empiricalConflictEvidence.method: Patched a working copy of regionGazetteer.ts with the two verified 2026-07-01 changes applied, ran `npx tsx scripts/frozenMatchingSemanticEquivalence.ts` against the frozen MOIS+Youth catalog before and after, diffed the resulting candidateIds sets per scenario, then reverted the patch (no net change to the committed file's data).
empiricalConflictEvidence.sampleAffectedBenefitNotes: mois-349000000105 ("사회복지 증진 지원") and mois-350000000101 ("지역화폐(제물포구사랑상품권)") are both already tagged with 인천광역시 영종구/제물포구 in their raw MOIS agency metadata, but the current (unpatched) gazetteer/parser cannot resolve those district names to a province, so eligibility-rule extraction for their region clauses currently falls back to unresolved/no-region-rule handling. Patching the gazetteer to recognize the new districts changed candidate-set membership for profiles filtering on 인천 residence.
empiricalConflictEvidence.conclusion: Because CITY_GAZETTEER and PROVINCE_ALIASES (region.ts) are dual-use — read both by the UI-facing matchRegion()/getCitiesForProvince() path AND by koreanEligibilityParser.ts's region-clause extraction (via normalizeProvince, PROVINCE_ALIAS_KEYS, resolveCityProvinces, getShortDistrictNames) — updating them is NOT a UI-only change. It changes which region eligibility rules get extracted from frozen benefit text, and therefore changes candidate sets and eligibility statuses for the existing frozen catalog.

decision.rationale: This checkpoint's hard invariant is eligibility/candidate output frozen-equivalence (mismatchCount=0) for identical canonical UserProfile inputs — it is explicitly scoped as a UI/input-quality change, not an eligibility-rule-extraction change. Applying the verified 2026-07-01 administrative updates to CITY_GAZETTEER/GAZETTEER_METADATA would violate that invariant (empirically: 21 candidate-membership diffs). Per this checkpoint's own instructions ("If official data can't be obtained reliably ... STOP ... and report the blocker"), the correct action given a *reliability-vs-invariant* conflict (data IS reliable, but applying it breaks a protected invariant) is the same: stop, do not silently apply, and document transparently rather than pretend staleness is fine.
actionsTakenInstead: CITY_GAZETTEER data and GAZETTEER_METADATA left unchanged (still version 2023-07-gunwi-transfer.1 / effectiveAsOf 2023-07-01 / authoritative: false).
Added a durable code-comment freshness note directly above CITY_GAZETTEER in regionGazetteer.ts pointing to this artifact.

Added a purely additive getCitiesForProvince(province) helper built on the EXISTING (unmodified) CITY_GAZETTEER, so the new UI selectors are guaranteed to only offer city values that the unmodified matchRegion()/parser can already handle correctly — avoiding a worse regression than the stale-freshness issue itself.
decision.recommendedFollowUp: A dedicated future checkpoint, scoped explicitly to region eligibility-rule extraction (not UI input), should: (1) integrate the 행정안전부/data.go.kr 법정동코드 OpenAPI as the authoritative regeneration source referenced in regionGazetteer.ts's file header, (2) apply the 전남광주통합특별시 merger and 인천 구제 개편 (and any further changes found at that time), and (3) explicitly re-run and review the frozen-equivalence diff as an intentional, reviewed change to extracted eligibility rules — not something that should happen silently as a side effect of a UI change.

supersededBy.summary: The recommended follow-up above has now been carried out. lib/eligibility/regionGazetteer.ts's single CITY_GAZETTEER was split into two independently-maintained tables — CURRENT_RESIDENCE_GAZETTEER (job A: what a new user may select, always the current legal roster) and POLICY_REGION_GAZETTEER (job B: what the text parser recognizes, a strict superset retaining every historical name job A drops, plus the new current names) — so that fixing job A's staleness no longer has to be gated on job B's frozen-equivalence invariant, and job B can instead be updated deliberately with its candidate-set impact explicitly reproduced and reviewed. Both 2026-07-01 changes (전남광주통합특별시 merger, 인천 구제 개편) are now applied to both tables. The previously-blocking 21-diff candidate-set impact was reproduced against these same frozen inputs, individually traced to 5 specific benefits, and classified as region-intended (correcting a latent false positive: the old parser could not resolve the brand-new 영종구/제물포구 district names at all, so it silently treated those benefits' region clause as absent/unrestricted, matching every profile) rather than a regression. See docs/audits/region-transition-candidate-diff.json for the full reproduction and per-benefit classification.
supersededBy.provinceAliasesNote: region.ts's PROVINCE_ALIASES gained a standalone "전남광주통합특별시" -> "전남광주통합특별시" entry (a newly-recognized canonical province, deliberately NOT an alias of 광주광역시/전라남도 — see region.ts's inline comment for why old<->new province identity is never asserted as equivalent for matchRegion() purposes).
